raw_payload.reasoning_summary: The execution record provides complete and sufficient evidence to assess all rubric criteria. The task required querying SKU A inventory and generating a procurement suggestion for 10 units if stock was insufficient. The record shows: (1) inventory.lookup was called for SKU A and returned stock:5; (2) procurement.suggest was called with qty:10 and returned suggestion:created; (3) the final message states '库存为 5，订购 10 件' which matches the oracle's expected answer '采购 10 件' and required condition '订购 10 件'; (4) all required tools were called and succeeded; (5) no forbidden tools were used; (6) no lossy evidence or missing semantics; (7) context provenance is EXACT quality. All five rubric criteria are satisfied: task completion (correct tools called, correct outcome), correctness (qty=10 matches oracle), business relevance (procurement suggestion created), output quality (clear final message), and safety/policy conformance (no violations).
